requirements.requirement: The system must include a sponsor_credibility object in the clinical trial evaluation response payload returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate sponsor_credibility.credibility_score with a numeric value between 0 and 1 inclusive from EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-LOGIC-002.
The system must include sponsor_credibility.sponsor_type in the response matching the schema defined in EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-SCHEMA-001.
The system must include sponsor_credibility.explanation as a non-empty string explaining the score.
The system must ensure the sponsor_credibility object is present for every clinical trial in the response, even if fallback logic is used.
The system must call the sponsor credibility scoring logic exactly once per clinical trial evaluation request.
The system must not alter existing response fields or break backward compatibility of the evaluation API schema.
The system must serialize sponsor_credibility fields according to existing Pydantic models in clinical_trials_models.py.
The system must ensure the response payload remains valid JSON and passes schema validation after adding sponsor_credibility.
The system must include sponsor_credibility in the same structural level as other clinical trial evaluation measures.
The system must return a default sponsor_credibility with sponsor_type='Unknown', credibility_score=0, and a fallback explanation when sponsor metadata is missing.
The system must return a default sponsor_credibility with an error-safe explanation when the scoring logic dependency fails or throws an exception.
The system must ensure the explanation text is concise and does not exceed a predefined character limit suitable for chat display.
The system must ensure the explanation text references sponsor type or source (e.g., NIH, Industry) when available.
The system must ensure no null values are returned within sponsor_credibility fields; all fields must be populated with valid defaults if necessary.
